templates.title: Qwen Code · ~/.qwen/.env
templates.instructions: Qwen Code reads its provider config from OpenAI-compatible environment variables (it auto-loads ~/.qwen/.env). With these set, `qwen` talks to the gateway in OpenAI wire format; the gateway translates to whatever the upstream natively speaks. `QWEN_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` caps each reply. If you'd rather not use the file, export the same variables in your shell.

companions.title: Qwen Code · ~/.qwen/settings.json
companions.instructions: Merge these keys into your existing ~/.qwen/settings.json — keep everything else in it. `selectedType: openai` makes Qwen Code use the variables above even if you signed in another way before (a project's own `.qwen/settings.json`, or a later `/auth`, still overrides it).{{#if context_window}} `contextWindowSize` tells Qwen Code the model's real context window, so it fits each reply in the room left and compacts the conversation in time; otherwise it assumes 200 000 tokens.{{/if}} Usage statistics and the update check are off (`privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled`, `general.enableAutoUpdate`); an admin who wants them back can edit this template.
